answer: The ridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the nebula is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
